split_rule: field test = every observer with any disease photo inside the fixed box lat 14.5..32.7, lon -118.4..-86.7 (Mexico and northern Central America; `in_mexico_box` in the attribution CSV), plus a random ~30 % of the other observers of each disease (seed 42, `model/inat_field.py`). The box was fixed before any v2 result and is kept unchanged so the test set stays the same; it has no special meaning for Kenya.
geo_rule: East Africa = Kenya, Uganda, Tanzania, Rwanda, Burundi and Ethiopia, approximated by the box lat -11.8..15.0, lon 28.8..48.0 (EAST_AFRICA_BOX in model/field_eval.py; it also takes in eastern DR Congo, South Sudan, Somalia, Eritrea, Djibouti and northern Zambia, Malawi and Mozambique, so every photo inside it is listed in the report). Kenya = inside a simplified 34-vertex outline of Kenya (KENYA_POLYGON; ray-casting point-in-polygon; borders accurate to roughly 10-30 km). Both use the observation's public location as rounded to 0.1 degree (about 11 km) in reports/field_inat_attribution.csv. Report subsets only: they never change the split, the training data or the threshold.

multicrop.rule: among schemes whose otro rejection on the VALIDATION split is >= 98 %, maximise roya correct on the field-dev photos (field_train split, never seen by the baseline), then validation coffee correct-and-accepted, then fewer crops
